overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the string form of expression (Real, Integer, Date, Time, Text, or Boolean) using the default format, or the format/addTime you specify.

discriminatedBy.rule: Applies when at most a display format and (for dates) an addTime are passed, as opposed to the numeric-base overload.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the string form of a numeric expression converted to the given base (radix), between 2 and 36.

discriminatedBy.rule: Applies when a second Integer parameter is passed as a radix (2-36) instead of a display format; only valid for numeric expression.

constraints: The String function is not compatible with "Integer 64 bits" type fields in compiled mode.
